summary: Residential cul-de-sac bend with cars parked, but homes close all round and steep.
reasons: Other cars park at the bend

best_section.where: Marston Avenue cul-de-sac bend, kerb on the south side by the vegetated lot

drivers.seclusion: Treed lot on the south side, but houses and pools surround the bend within about 10-25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street end with a widened turning head; cars already stand there so room to pull in exists.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end residential street, very little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Two cars parked at the bend in the imagery; no signs mapped.

flags: Steep: about 10% mean, 12.8% max over the stretch
Mapped building 9 m from the kerb (not tagged as a home)
Brisbane River 277 m away, elevation 25 m, not flood-prone
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy on the south and east side shades the section from morning sun.
